title: Quota
description: Resource projection derived from QuotaUpdated events. Only cognitive_tokens and repairs are abort-authoritative (see ../GOAL.md §10). uncertainty/focus_score removed in — no undefined-threshold authority.

cognitive_tokens.description: Sum of input+output tokens across ALL roles (Maker/Checker/advisors/format-repair); missing usage must be conservatively estimated, never recorded as zero.

cognitive_tokens_by_role.description: Per-role breakdown for auditability; keys are role names.

repairs_used.description: Sum of repair_counts values; authoritative abort compares each (obligation_id, reason) entry against repairs_max (see projections.md REPAIRS_MAX).

repair_counts.description: Per (obligation_id, reason) repair tally; keys are obligation_id + ':' + reason (reason empty string if absent). SSOT for repairs_exhausted abort.
